MEET THE ARTIST / 공원

gongwon

gongwon’s “Flower” follows someone who wants to keep growing, even when they dislike what they see in themselves. It appears on the EP 0, also featured in the live session below.

The speaker in “Flower” hoped to bloom, but compares themselves to mold in a damp room. The song pairs that harsh self-image with a wish to keep growing and be loved. This is the official recording from gongwon’s EP 0.

Lyrics by gongwon; music by gongwon and Bae Do Hyub; arranged by Bae Do Hyub. First released as a single on 30 January 2026, then included on 0 on 24 February 2026.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Growing in a damp room

  • Self-acceptance
  • Self-worth

The official English title is Flower, while 곰팡이 means “mold.” The difference matters to a speaker who expected one kind of growth and sees another in themselves. A damp room gives that disappointment a physical setting: what grows there is shaped by its conditions.

The harsh self-description is part of the speaker’s struggle with worth. Continuing to grow has not brought an easy sense of pride, yet the wish to be loved persists. The lyric holds that wish beside the feelings the speaker finds difficult to accept, leaving self-acceptance unfinished.
